system.flavor: Now, a close-in support weapon that can stop a cyberpsycho cold; nearly an express rifle in design! A four-chamber, pepperbox-style gun with a folding arm brace for support.
system.notes:
Solo of Fortune p.50 (PDF idx 51) text layer prints: R 1 N E .477* 4 2 VR, $450, with the range-damage footnote *PB&CL=5D6, M&L=3D6+4, E=2D6 (recorded in rangeDamages).

Stat cells taken from Blackhand's Street Weapons p.17 (PDF idx 18), which reprints it complete and cites [Solo of Fortune]: P +1/-1 J/L P 5D6AP (.477) 4 1 VR 50M, 450eb. Blackhand's note: Acc. and Conceal. drop to -1 / L unless the firer has the brace deployed or a cyberarm. Blackhand's classes it a heavy handgun; SoF prints type R.
